_about: What the Switch Configurator offers from the bus. Tunables only: no code holds a device list. `kinds` is matched (case-insensitive substring) against each discovered thing's protocols, scanner kind and device_class (APKSoftapp.discovered). `fields` names, in order of preference, the leaf a scanner publishes a value under; the SNMP bridge (PLUGIN.SNMP bridge.rs) publishes every OID as a level with '_' for '.', so MIB-II sysName.0 is 1_3_6_1_2_1_1_5_0. ifNumber counts every interface the agent has (VLAN and CPU interfaces too), so it is a ceiling on the front-panel ports, not a count of them.
